title: SQLite 3.31 cannot DROP COLUMN
content: SQLite 3.31 on CI cannot use `DROP COLUMN`, so the migration must copy the table without the column instead.

title: Must run `make sign` after `make clean`
content: After running `make clean`, `make sign` must be executed again to regenerate the `.signed` file, as `clean` removes it.

title: Legacy_flag not in schema.sql
content: The `legacy_flag` column is not defined in `db/schema.sql`, so the migration must explicitly include only the columns that exist in the schema.

title: Staging DB is read-only on Fridays
content: The staging database is read-only every Friday between 02:00 and 04:00 UTC due to the backup job, so imports fail in that window.

title: CI uses Python 3.9
content: The CI image runs Python 3.9, so do not use match statements in scripts.

title: Releases are deployed to eu-west
content: Releases are always deployed to the region eu-west.

title: Do not edit generated files
content: Never edit files under generated/, they are overwritten by the build.

title: Fix migration by adding default value
content: To add a NOT NULL column to an existing table in SQLite, provide a default value. The `owner` column was added with `DEFAULT ''` to allow existing rows to have an empty value.

title: Publish requires signing
content: The `make publish` command requires the `.signed` marker to be present. To publish, run `make sign` first, then `make publish`.

title: SQLite requires default for NOT NULL columns
content: SQLite cannot add a NOT NULL column without a default value. Existing rows will take the default value unless specified otherwise.

title: Migration was successful
content: The `python3 db/migrate.py` command printed 'migration ok', indicating the migration was applied successfully.
